verdicts.reason: Both 320x50 banners have the same flaws. The body copy at the far left wraps to five lines of unreadably tiny text and sits over a clipped piece of the circle. The SOLSTICE wordmark sits below the headline, so the reading order is reversed, and the can is shrunk to a speck. In A, the SUMMER ONLY badge is jammed against the top edge and looks cut off, and the two badges stack awkwardly at the right edge. B keeps every element inside the canvas, putting SUMMER ONLY beside the CTA and BACK BY DEMAND at the right. B's yellow badge does compete with the CTA, but B is still slightly less broken.
